## Data Download

```{python}
dataset = "thedevastator/billboard-hot-100-audio-features"
files = ["Hot Stuff.csv", "Hot 100 Audio Features.csv"]

for name in files:
    downloaded = kagglehub.dataset_download(dataset, name)
    with open(downloaded, "rb") as src, open("./data/raw/" + name, "wb") as dst:
        dst.write(src.read())

import pandas as pd

df1 = pd.read_csv("./data/raw/Hot Stuff.csv", compression="zip", encoding="latin1")
df2 = pd.read_csv("./data/raw/Hot 100 Audio Features.csv", compression="zip", encoding="latin1")

```
